newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Bendigo says rights issue not finalised.
newsitem.headline: Bendigo says rights issue not finalised.

text.p: Bendigo Mining NL said on Tuesday it had sought a trading halt on its stock due to the hasty release of a press statement on Monday dealing with a proposed rights issue.
The gold exploration company said it had not finalised documentation for the rights issue.

Some newspapers said on Tuesday that the company had issued a statement saying it had signed papers for a fully underwritten A$34 million one-for-one rights issue but had quickly advised the media that this was not the case.
